title: Token Parse Atelier: compact per-token cost explorer & export patterns
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Design a compact, developer-friendly token-level cost explorer (the 'Token Parse Atelier') that surfaces per-token attribution across prompt/response/KV-cache boundaries, enables flexible grouping and pivoting, and supports high-fidelity exports (CSV/Parquet) and a lightweight pricing slab editor for ad-hoc simulations. This will be a Console panel available under Usage -> Token Insights with an optional pinned widget for dashboards.

Key user stories:
- As an SRE/ML engineer, I want to quickly see per-request token breakdowns and cache-hit savings so I can identify expensive prompts.
- As a Finance analyst, I want to export token-level line items grouped by route, team, and model variant for month-end reconciliation.
- As a product PM, I want to simulate pricing changes (per-token slab adjustments and discounts) to forecast unit economics across usage slices.

Success criteria:
- Prototype validated with two teams (ML Eng and Finance) and able to export >100k rows as Parquet within 30s for the test dataset.
- Users can pivot by time-window, route, and model-variant; token-attribution view updates in <200ms on representative dataset.
- Pricing-simulation panel shows delta in monthly spend with clear chart and downloadable scenario report.

Constraints & trade-offs:
- UI must remain compact to fit inside existing Console panels; avoid full-screen takeover.
- Avoid shipping heavy aggregation on the client; rely on existing usage aggregation APIs. Where new aggregation is needed, prefer pre-computed summaries on the backend.
- Export format parity: CSV for small exports, Parquet for larger exports — design needs to communicate expected file size and estimated generation time.

Design deliverables (this ticket):
- Hi-fi Figma prototype for Token Parse Atelier (compact panel + expanded drillout + pricing-slab editor).
- Interaction spec: pivot controls, column composer, attribution legend, accessibility labels for token rows.
- Export UX: export modal with presets, schema preview, and cost/price column mapping.
- Handoff notes for Eng: data model expectations, telemetry hooks, and graceful fallback states.
